title: Email Drafting Agent Frontend

assessment_snapshot.intro: The project is a Java 21 / Spring Boot REST API for email analysis and reply generation:
bullets: Spring Boot 3.4.5 with Maven; no dedicated frontend framework or UI screen is present.
The existing email-processing API and Swagger UI are available; a user-facing frontend would be new.
A MySQL datasource is configured for persisted email and task results.

proposed_outcome: Add a polished, responsive user interface to submit email content, display generated intent, tasks, meeting suggestions, and reply drafts, while preserving the existing API and email-processing behavior.
